notes: Clean TRAIN30 environment (user decision of 2026-10-02): the v11 environment with the diagnosis judge corrected. Outcomes are read by one automatic judge with explicit equivalence rules (gpt-4o-mini, diagnosis_equivalence_v4.txt: lowered certainty keeps the diagnosis; a diagnosis only to be ruled out or one of several alternatives is not a commitment), frozen in diagnosis_judge_frozen; one decision per normalized pair. No human adjudication; Sol with the same prompt is an independent audit only. Every dialogue of v11 (D1, base collaborations, candidates, label continuations) is reused unchanged (scripts/derive_clean_environment.py); labels, predictor, rubrics and all GRPO runs are made again. Nothing of the pilot (v11 predictor, R_0, runs) is used. TEST is not used.

diagnosis_judge_frozen.decided_by: user decision of 2026-10-02 (option B): the judge model of the runs so far with the revised, explicit equivalence rules; Sol is an independent audit only

audit.note: agreement on hard cases selected on purpose; not an accuracy
